# Consul API Gateway repository archived

The [`hashicorp/consul-api-gateway`](https://github.com/hashicorp/consul-api-gateway) GitHub repository is archived. Consul API gateway development continues in the main [`hashicorp/consul`](https://github.com/hashicorp/consul) repository.

## Native API gateway in Consul v1.15 and later

Since Consul v1.15, the API gateway is a native Consul feature.

## Next steps

- Read the [Consul release notes](/consul/docs/release-notes) for API gateway changes in current releases.
- [Upgrade API gateway for Kubernetes](/consul/docs/upgrade/api-gateway) to move from a standalone release to the native API gateway.
- Learn how to [deploy and configure API gateways](/consul/docs/north-south/api-gateway).
